fluff.overview: The Carrion Crow is a Raven Alliance OmniMech designed alongside the heavier and more expensive War Crow.
fluff.capabilities: An extralight engine drives the 'Mech at a top speed of 111km/h. Protection for the engine and Endo-Steel chassis is provided by nine and a half tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor. Fourteen and a half tons of pod space allows the Carrion Crow to carry weapons that let it effectively fight heavier units.
fluff.deployment: This configuration carries a HAG 20 and three tons of armor in the left arm. The center torso carries an Improved Heavy Medium Laser, and the head has an ER Small Laser.
fluff.history: Deployment of the Carrion Crow is limited to the Raven touman with the Alliance Military Corps not receiving any of these 'Mechs. A fast 'Mech, the Carrion Crow is intended to be a standard medium 'Mech for the Alliance.
